Naafiri.gap_summary: GAP: Q packet models only 'Initial Physical Damage' (35-55 + 20% bAD); wiki Q also has Total Bleed 35-135 + 80% bAD (atoms damage.dot NaafiriQ), recast bonus damage 30-160 + 40-140% bAD (atoms damage.execute NaafiriQ), and a self-heal row (Heal 45-105 + 40% bAD, effect[1]) — none modeled, Naafiri absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. E packet models only 'Dash Physical Damage' (15-55 + 40% bAD); the Flurry explosion (60-160 + 80% bAD, ~80% of E's Total Physical Damage 75-215 + 120% bAD) is missing. P packmate summon and W/R shields (atoms heal-shield.shield NaafiriW/NaafiriRShield) are declared out_of_scope.

Nami.gap_summary: GAP: W 'Ebb and Flow' is modeled as damage only (60-200 + 50% AP — correct row); the heal component (Heal 55-155 + 40% AP, atoms heal-shield.heal NamiW) is unmodeled and Nami is absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. E packet models per-hit bonus (20-80 + 20% AP) not the 3-hit Total Bonus Magic Damage (60-240 + 60% AP). CC (Q/R knock-up, E slow) is utility out of scope.

notable_atoms: damage over time (E Spirit Fire zone)
max-health damage per tick (R Fury of the Sands)
Nasus.gap_summary: GAP: Q stack scaling is lost — wiki Q 'Bonus Physical Damage' = 40-120 + 100% of Siphoning Strike stacks, but '% of Siphoning Strike stacks' is an unrecognized unit in scaling.py (resolve_scaling returns 0.0), so Q models only the flat 40-120 with no stack input (atom stack NasusQStacks). E packet models the initial hit only (50-170 + 60% AP); the per-tick DoT (10-34 + 12% AP, atoms damage.dot NasusE) is unmodeled. P lifesteal 12-24% unmodeled (not in HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS).

Nautilus.gap_summary: REVIEW: all 5 slots modeled as packets; Q/E/R damage rows match the wiki. P packet base 0.75-1.5 with no ratio looks like the %max-HP 'Bonus Damage' row read as a flat amount while the 14-128 per-level flat term is dropped (atoms only record the P root, WS4 missed P damage). W packet = per-hit magic damage (15-35 + 20% AP, count null) not the Total Magic Damage 30-70 + 40% AP; the W shield (atoms heal-shield.shield NautilusPiercingGazeShield) is unmodeled. Needs judgment on P/W numeric intent.

Neeko.gap_summary: REVIEW: Q/W/E/R damage rows modeled (Q initial 60-260 + 60% AP, W on-hit bonus 30-170 + 60% AP, E 70-210 + 65% AP, R 150-550 + 120% AP). Q's 'Subsequent Magic Damage' bounces (35-135 + 25% AP) not modeled. P disguise transform, W clone/stealth (atoms stack-transform-summon-resource.transform/clone, vision-economy.stealth) and R shield (atoms heal-shield.shield NeekoRShield) are out_of_scope; W packet models only the on-hit damage of a clone/utility slot.

notable_atoms: transform (R Aspect of the Cougar, human/cougar forms)
Nidalee.gap_summary: GAP: E Primal Surge heal (50-300 + 35-70% AP, atoms heal-shield.heal PrimalSurge) is unmodeled and Nidalee is absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS — the human-form E slot is not modeled at all (packet E = cougar Swipe only). Form switching is partially expressed via q_variant/w_variant options (defaults = human Javelin Toss / Bushwhack; cougar Takedown/Pounce selectable). Javelin Toss packet uses only the MAXIMUM damage row (227.5-487.5 + 162.5% AP, full range) with no min/range option; Bushwhack packet = per-tick 10-50 + 5% AP (count null) not the 4-tick Total 40-200 + 20% AP.

notable_atoms: heal + overheal-shield (P Joy Unending, Q Formless Blade, R Apotheosis)
crit-scaled damage (Q min 100% AD / max 191% AD)
Nilah.gap_summary: GAP: the whole heal/shield family is unmodeled — P shield and Q/R heal+shield atoms (NilahPShield, NilahQ, NilahR heal-shield entries; wiki: heal 0-20% of post-mitigation damage, overheal converts to shield), and Nilah is absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. Q packet uses the crit-scaled MAXIMUM damage (0-76.4 + 191% AD) as a flat value with no crit input (min is 0-40 + 100% AD) and drops the passive heal/armor-pen. R packet models per-tick (15-35 + 10% bAD) not the Total 60-140 + 40% bAD plus burst. W parry (atoms interaction.parry NilahW) out_of_scope.

notable_atoms: self-heal on P hit (wiki; not in atom file)
Nocturne.gap_summary: REVIEW: P/Q/E/R damage rows modeled (P 13-32 + 30% AP, Q 65-225 + 85% bAD, E per-tick 20-65 + 25% AP, R 150-400 + 120% bAD). P's self-heal (13-32 + 30% AP per enemy hit) exists in the wiki cache but NOT in the atom file (WS4 missed it), so no atom-level gap; E packet models per-tick damage (count null) while the wiki Total Magic Damage is 80-260 + 100% AP over 4 ticks. W spell shield + CC immunity (atoms heal-shield.shield, crowd-control-mobility.cc-immunity) declared out_of_scope.

notable_atoms: self-heal (Q Consume, +50% below half HP, 60% vs champions)
Nunu.gap_summary: GAP: Q packet models 'Non-Champion True Damage' (400-1200) — the wrong basis for a champion-combat calculator; vs champions Consume deals 'Champion Magic Damage' 60-220 + 65% AP + 5% bHP (wiki effect[2]) which is unmodeled, and the Q self-heal (39-111 + 54% AP + 6% bHP vs champions; atoms list Q damage but the wiki heal is absent from the atom file) is unmodeled with Nunu absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. E packet models the Snowbound detonation row (20-60 + 80% AP) instead of the barrage (per-hit 15-45 + 12% AP x3 = Total 45-135 + 36% AP per cast). R shield (atoms heal-shield.shield NunuRShield) out_of_scope.

Olaf.gap_summary: REVIEW: Q (70-270 + 100% bAD) and E (70-250 + 50% AD true damage) packets match the wiki. W shield (10-130 + 17.5% missing health, atoms heal-shield.shield OlafWShield/OlafFrenziedStrikes), P lifesteal 8-27.67%, E health-cost self-damage + kill-heal, and R CC immunity are all explicitly out_of_scope; no heal atoms in the file, so the missing mechanics are defensive/utility by design.

Orianna.gap_summary: OK: custom module models all slots — P stack ramp on-hit (fail-loud stack-cap reconstruction), Q/W/R full damage, E pass-through damage with e_passes_through_target option. E shield (55-195 + 45% AP) and bonus resistances, W speed field, R stun/pull are explicitly excluded in ASSUMPTIONS (defensive/utility), matching atoms (heal-shield.shield OrianaRedactShield, crowd-control-mobility.ghost/stun). No damage-relevant atom family missing.

Ornn.gap_summary: OK: custom module models Q (20-120 + 110% AD), W (5 sourced 0.15s ticks = Total Magic Damage 12-16% max HP), E (Physical Damage 80-260), R (2 passes default, r_passes option, Total Magic Damage 250-450 + 40% AP). P item forge (atoms damage.tag-item OrnnPGrantItem/OrnnPAllyItemGive) declared out of scope with documented assumption; Brittle state exposed in detail receipts; Q pillar terrain and E knock-up are CC/state mechanics not damage. E's bonus-armor/MR scaling (% bonus armor / % bonus magic resistance) is supported by scaling.py.

Pantheon.gap_summary: GAP: Q packet models only the base 'Hurl Physical Damage' (70-190 + 115% bAD + 50% AP); the execute version 'Increased Hurl Damage' (155-455 + 230% bAD + 100% AP vs <20% HP, atoms damage.execute PantheonQ) and the Mortal Will empowered-Q per-level term (20-265.88, P stack mechanic) are unmodeled. Also inconsistent: the packet contains a W (Shield Vault, %max-HP wiki_attribute) spec but MODULE_COVERAGE declares W out_of_scope. E parry/CC-immunity (atoms interaction.parry PantheonE) and E shield-slam are out_of_scope. R = center damage (300-700 + 100% AP), edge reduced damage unmodeled.

Poppy.gap_summary: REVIEW: all 5 slots modeled; Q double-hit is correctly handled (packet_module doubles total, 1s interval). P packet models only the %max-HP term (0.11-0.2106 ratio, base 0) and drops the flat 'Bonus Magic Damage' 20-198.82 (based on level); the P buckler shield (atoms heal-shield.shield PoppyPassiveShield) is unmodeled. R packet = uncharged damage (100-200 + 45% bAD); the charged 'Increased Damage' 200-400 + 90% bAD is not modeled. W/E rows match.

notable_atoms: grey-health self-heal (P Gift of the Drowned Ones)
Pyke.gap_summary: GAP: P grey-health heal (atoms heal-shield.heal PykePHealON/PykePHealOFF) is unmodeled and Pyke is absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. R packet is a 13-value array (375-825 = 1.5x the per-level execute threshold 250-550) with no AD/lethality scaling and rank-pinned to the first 3 values (levels 6-8) — the wiki damage is 125-275 + 40% bAD + 0.75/Lethality (50% of threshold) for non-executed targets; needs human validation. Q melee/hook variants (atom stack-transform-summon-resource.ranged-melee-reclassification PykeQMelee) and W stealth (vision-economy.stealth) are out_of_scope; Q/E damage rows match.

notable_atoms: execute (Q terrain below-50% HP increased damage; P per-target cooldown)
on-hit riders (P Royal Privilege, W Terrashape)
Qiyana.gap_summary: OK: custom module models P on-hit (15-91 + 25% bAD + 30% AP), Q element variants (q_variant 0-2 with q_target_below_half option covering the terrain execute), W on-hit rider (8-40 + 20% bAD + 45% AP), E (50-210 + 50% bAD), R (100-300 + 125% bAD + 10% max HP — full wiki row). Stealth/root/wall CC (atoms vision-economy.stealth, crowd-control-mobility.root, summon terrain) are utility out of scope; R's damage row is fully modeled (the atom rule:execute on R/P reflects the below-half/wall conditionals, already expressible via options).

notable_atoms: transform/channel (R Behind Enemy Lines) + dive damage (Skystrike)
Quinn.gap_summary: GAP: P Harrier on-hit bonus damage (15-132.35 + 40% bAD, atoms stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo QuinnPassiveAmmo) is declared out_of_scope while equivalent damage passives are modeled elsewhere (Nocturne P, Qiyana P, Orianna P all emit ONHIT entries) — inconsistent coverage of the on-hit family. Q/E damage rows match (Q 65-205 + 80-100% bAD + 50% AP; E 40-140 + 20% bAD). R packet = Skystrike dive damage (60-120 + 35% bAD); the R transform (Valor channel, atoms transform QuinnR) is out_of_scope.

notable_atoms: shield (P Fey Feathers, E Battle Dance)
Rakan.gap_summary: GAP: the heal/shield family is entirely unmodeled — P shield (30-247.94 + 95% AP, atoms heal-shield.shield RakanPassiveShield), Q heal (40-230 + 50% AP, atoms heal-shield.heal RakanQHeal/RakanQ) and E shield (50-150 + 70% AP, atoms RakanEShield); Rakan is absent from HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS. The module's assumptions explicitly exclude the Q ally heal ('its ally heal is excluded') and P/E slots are absent from SLOTS entirely; Q/W/R damage rows match the wiki. A human should confirm heal/shield exclusion policy.

notable_atoms: return magic damage on-hit (W Defensive Ball Curl)
Rammus.gap_summary: GAP: W packet mis-models the damage — packet base 27-47 + 30-60% total armor matches the wiki 'Bonus Armor' row (a defensive buff), but Defensive Ball Curl's actual damage is 15 + 10% total armor + 10% total magic resistance (rank-independent, wiki effect[0]); the wiki cache has no damage leveling row for W so the packet reused the armor row as magic damage. Q (80-240 + 100% AP) and R (150-350 + 60% AP) rows match. E taunt (atoms crowd-control-mobility.taunt) and P spiked-shell are out_of_scope.

notable_atoms: true damage at max Fury (E Furious Bite 120%)
RekSai.gap_summary: REVIEW: Q variants (Queen's Wrath 30-50% AD on-hit; Prey Seeker 50-170 + 25% bAD + 70% AP), W Unburrow (30-130 + 80% AP), E Furious Bite physical (70-170 + 60% bAD) and R Void Rush (150-350 + 100% bAD + 15-25% max HP) match the wiki. The max-Fury E variant (True Damage 84-204 + 72% bAD, atoms RekSaiE true-damage note) is unmodeled (no fury state option). P regen (atoms heal-shield.health-regeneration RekSaiPRegen) and P max-HP damage, tunnel summon, and burrow CC are out_of_scope; burrow form state is only partially expressible via q_variant.

notable_atoms: on-hit bonus damage (P Break the Mold, E Full Tilt empowered attack)
Rell.gap_summary: REVIEW: Q (60-220 + 60% AP), W variants (Crash Down 60-180 + 60% AP; Mount Up 10-70 + 40% AP) and R per-tick (18.75-43.75 + 13.75% AP; total 150-350 + 110% AP not expressed) match the wiki. E Full Tilt is declared out_of_scope in MODULE_COVERAGE even though the packet contains its wiki_attribute spec (inconsistency), and P on-hit (5% armor + 5% MR, atoms RellP_Buff/Debuff), W shield (20-100 + 11% max HP, atoms RellW_Shield) and Q shield-breaking are unmodeled. Mount/dismount form is expressible via w_variant.

Renata.gap_summary: REVIEW: Q (80-260 + 80% AP) and E (65-185 + 55% AP) damage rows match. P Leverage on-hit mark damage (1-2% max HP per level, atoms stack-transform-summon-resource.debuff RenataPassiveDebuff), E shield (50-110 + 50% AP, atoms heal-shield.shield RenataE), W bailout/revive (atoms buff) and R berserk (atoms RenataRDebuff) are all declared out_of_scope — the module models only the two damaging abilities, which is defensible but leaves the kit's utility families (heal-shield, debuff, summon-free) unexpressed.
